# CargoSteer Transport

> Freight booking portal and commercial transporter coordination system for companies and factories.

- Primary URL: https://mtd006.github.io/cargosteer/
- Platform: web portal + Android client access
- Use case: freight quotation, vehicle sourcing, shipment tracking, LR documents, invoices, billing, and support

## Summary
CargoSteer is a digital logistics and transporter-service portal. The site presents a workflow for lane enquiry, commercial confirmation, shipment movement, document access, and closure. The homepage also includes a visible SEO layer explaining third party transporter coordination, market vehicle hiring, B2B freight service, and dashboard-based client operations.

## Key search topics
freight booking portal, transport management portal, shipment tracking dashboard, local transporter quotes, market vehicle hiring, client logistics dashboard, LR copies, invoice visibility, B2B transport service, digital freight workflow
